options.traditional: 他們家的孩子一歲比一歲高。
options.simplified: 他们家的孩子一岁比一岁高。
options.note: 一歲 compares ages over time; A compares different children, counted with 個.

segments.traditional: 他們家三個孩子都只差一歲，可是年紀越小個子越高。
segments.simplified: 他们家三个孩子都只差一岁，可是年纪越小个子越高。

sentence.traditional: 他們家的孩子一個比一個高。
sentence.simplified: 他们家的孩子一个比一个高。
sentence.pinyin: Tāmen jiā de háizi yí ge bǐ yí ge gāo.
sentence.english: Each child in their family is taller than the previous one.

repairs.note: 比 compares successive children; 跟 alone does not form this comparison.

options.simplified: 他拍的电影一部比一部受欢迎。

result.traditional: 他拍的電影一部比一部受歡迎。
result.simplified: 他拍的电影一部比一部受欢迎。
result.pinyin: Tā pāi de diànyǐng yí bù bǐ yí bù shòu huānyíng.
result.english: Each film he makes is more popular than the last.

options.traditional: 他拍的電影一張比一張受歡迎。
options.simplified: 他拍的电影一张比一张受欢迎。
options.note: Movies are counted with 部; 張 counts flat objects such as photos.

options.traditional: 他拍的電影比一部一部受歡迎。
options.simplified: 他拍的电影比一部一部受欢迎。
options.note: Place 比 between the two matching 一部 units.

segments.traditional: 張導演拍電影的技巧越來越好，拍出來的電影也越來越受歡迎了。
segments.simplified: 张导演拍电影的技巧越来越好，拍出来的电影也越来越受欢迎了。

sentence.traditional: 他拍的電影一部比一部受歡迎。
sentence.simplified: 他拍的电影一部比一部受欢迎。
sentence.pinyin: Tā pāi de diànyǐng yí bù bǐ yí bù shòu huānyíng.
sentence.english: Each film he makes is more popular than the last.

repairs.note: 一場 counts a showing or event; 一部 counts each film he makes.

result.english: My money is decreasing day by day.

options.traditional: 我的錢一天比一天多了。
options.simplified: 我的钱一天比一天多了。
options.note: 多 says your money is increasing; your savings are running low.

options.traditional: 我的錢一天少比一天了。
options.simplified: 我的钱一天少比一天了。
options.note: Put 少 after the second 一天, not before 比.

situation.traditional: 你還沒找到工作，存在銀行的錢越來越少了，下星期還要付房租，你想向父母借錢。你怎麼跟他們說？
situation.simplified: 你还没找到工作，存在银行的钱越来越少了，下星期还要付房租，你想向父母借钱。你怎么跟他们说？
situation.english: You have not found work, your bank savings are decreasing and rent is due next week. You want to borrow from your parents. What do you say?

sentence.traditional: 我的錢一天比一天少了。
sentence.simplified: 我的钱一天比一天少了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de qián yì tiān bǐ yì tiān shǎo le.
sentence.english: My money is decreasing day by day.

repairs.note: Use matching units: 一天比一天 describes the continuing decline.

result.pinyin: Fùmǔ de tǐlì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
result.english: Our parents' strength is declining year by year.

options.traditional: 父母的體力一個比一個差了。
options.simplified: 父母的体力一个比一个差了。
options.note: 一個 compares different people; 一年 describes the parents' decline over time.

options.traditional: 父母的體力一年比一年好了。
options.simplified: 父母的体力一年比一年好了。
options.note: 好 says their strength is improving; the situation says it is declining.

situation.traditional: 你父母的年紀越來越大，體力也沒以前好了，你想趁過年放假，跟妹妹一起帶他們出國旅行。你怎麼跟妹妹說？
situation.simplified: 你父母的年纪越来越大，体力也没以前好了，你想趁过年放假，跟妹妹一起带他们出国旅行。你怎么跟妹妹说？
situation.english: Your parents are aging and have less strength. You want to take them abroad with your younger sister during the New Year break. What do you say?
